changes.newText: If some of the selected users cannot be permanently deleted, a failure dialog lists each affected user's email together with the error message, while the remaining users are purged normally.
changes.newHtml:
If some of the selected users cannot be permanently deleted, a failure dialog lists each affected
user's email together with the error message, while the remaining users are purged normally.

changes.oldText: On the Sessions tab, you can use the property filter to narrow the list, including by Session ID when needed.
changes.newText: On the Sessions tab, you can use the property filter to narrow the list — by Session ID when needed, by the session's owner (email or full name), by its project or domain, and by session attributes such as result, cluster mode, priority, and creation or termination time.

changes.diffHtml: On the Sessions tab, you can use the property filter to narrow the list, including— by Session ID when needed, by the session's owner (email or full name), by its project or domain, and by session attributes such as result, cluster mode, priority, and creation or termination time.

changes.newText: Exporting the list as a CSV file applies the property filter currently in effect, so you can narrow the list first and export only the sessions you need. Filter conditions the export does not support are ignored, so the exported file may contain more sessions than the table shows, never fewer.
changes.newHtml:
Exporting the list as a CSV file applies the property filter currently in effect, so you can narrow the
list first and export only the sessions you need. Filter conditions the export does not support are
ignored, so the exported file may contain more sessions than the table shows, never fewer.
